mapper.sql: SELECT i.id AS identity_id, i.password_hash, i.display_name AS identity_name, t.id AS tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, m.id AS membership_id, m.version FROM identity i JOIN membership m ON m.identity_id = i.id JOIN tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE i.status = 'active' AND m.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'active'
